subtopics: PyTest fixtures and independent test data
Parameterised valid, invalid and boundary cases
Page objects and separation of assertions
Explicit browser waits and reliable selectors
modules.deliverable: PyTest suite, cart fixtures, checkout page object, failure diagnostics and reports for faulty and corrected builds
modules.lab: Extend a supplied local shop and test skeleton. Create independent cart fixtures, page objects and parameterised quantity tests for -1, 0, 1, 5 and 6 under an allowed range of 1 to 5. Run against a seeded faulty build and a corrected build. Capture failure diagnostics and rerun in reverse case order.
modules.assessment: The faulty build fails the designated invalid-quantity cases. The corrected build passes all five cases. Reversing execution order preserves results. Each failed case reports input, expected behaviour and observed behaviour; no fixed sleep is used as the only readiness check.
learning_objectives: Detect acceptance of invalid checkout quantities through observable assertions
Eliminate shared-cart state so case order does not affect results
Separate application defects from test setup failures using captured diagnostics

delivery_steps.activity: Inspect the starter and trace fixtures, selectors and assertions
delivery_steps.evidence: One isolated checkout test

delivery_steps.evidence: Executable suite and faulty-build report

delivery_steps.activity: Remove state leakage and test corrected build in reverse order
delivery_steps.evidence: Stable comparison reports

delivery_steps.activity: Explain every seeded failure and demonstrate cleanup
delivery_steps.evidence: Reviewed framework and evidence
